CustomField.description: REV-60: optional currency qualifier for Product Base rows (ISO code, e.g. USD). When set, the row applies only to lines in that currency and beats the plain product row — used for the per-currency PCGE promo bases (PCE01=USD, PCE02=EUR, PCE03=GBP; Cindy 13 Jul 2026). Blank = any currency.
CustomField.label: Currency
